title: Bear River High School Flea Market
passage:
Bear River High School Flea Market

Next Saturday, April 11

Do you want to create space in your closet? Your old clothes could be somebody's new favorite. Give five things to our flea market and take one item home for free.

How?
Donations will be accepted in the school gym between April 5th and April 10th. Receive a ticket for one free item on the day of the sale for every five pieces of clothing you bring.

What?
All kinds of clothing and sizes welcome, except underwear, socks, and shoes.

Important note
We also accept hats, bags, scarves, gloves, necklaces, and rings. Remember that all items must be clean.

All money raised will be given to local animal charities.

Don't take food or drink into the gym. Please bring cash to the sale, as we will not take credit cards.

If you're interested in helping out or want to find out more, phone Mrs. Pratt on 555-3245.
